threshold_basis: AnyVisLoc authors recommend 3/5/10 m evaluation; 3 m proposed before this campaign was inspected. This is not a mission safety requirement.

input_meanings.log_agl_m: Natural log of supplied AGL in metres; GT/DSM-derived experimental input.
input_meanings.map_coverage: Prior-centred rectangle coverage within raster bounds, computed before SIFT extraction/matching.
input_meanings.log_search_to_footprint_ratio: Natural log of full requested prior-centred search area divided by supplied planar footprint area.
input_meanings.log_projection_condition: Natural log of the rectification projection condition, computed before matching.
input_meanings.log_footprint_area_m2: Natural log of planar footprint area from supplied K/attitude/AGL, independent of GT XY.
input_meanings.log_query_bbox_pixels: Natural log of rectified query bounding-box pixel count; included as a geometry/scale control.
input_meanings.log_query_keypoint_density_mpx: log(1 + query SIFT keypoints per million rectified bounding-box pixels). Query extraction precedes correspondence search. Proxy for feature content, not a blur measurement; affected by mask, scale and feature budget.
input_meanings.log_reference_crop_pixels: Natural log of the reference crop pixel count; known before matching. Controls density denominator and resampling geometry.
input_meanings.log_reference_keypoint_density_mpx: log(1 + reference SIFT keypoints per million crop pixels). Map-only proxy computed before correspondence search; affected by the 6000-feature budget, crop, resampling, padding and scene content. Not a pure texture or blur metric.

split.final_test: Scene_21 (not included; no matching outcomes observed)

prohibited_model_inputs: actual footprint coverage at GT XY
scope: Fixed SIFT/aerial map, synthetic XY prior sigma=20m, ideal attitude and DSM-derived AGL, domain 20-120m.
limitations: Two working scenes and one unseen test scene provide limited cross-scene evidence.
Adjacent frames are correlated; do not randomly split frames across train and validation.
Raster coverage ignores internal padding; valid-image coverage is not established.
Query-keypoint density is available after query feature extraction but before map correspondence search.
R is uncalibrated; no flight risk model or scene-general probability guarantee is established.
Primary planner-oriented comparisons must not use query-image features as if they were known pre-flight.
Map keypoint density can saturate at the fixed detector budget; evaluate its utility rather than assuming it is an adequate map-quality metric.

input_availability.geometry: Supplied camera geometry and prior; future use requires available or specified planned values.
input_availability.geometry_and_map_features: Reference-map extraction can be performed offline for specified map crops; no query-image feature values are used.
input_availability.geometry_and_query_features: Online pre-match only: requires the actual camera image and query extraction. Not directly available to a pre-flight planner.
